location.site_description: Existing Coit Road Data Center / Lincoln Rackhouse campus at the southeast corner of Coit Road and Jomar Drive; 23.8-acre data-center lot in Plano planning records.

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live / expansion fit-up registered as of 2026-08-11
evidence_grade: A- for location, local approval, and registered 2026 fit-up; B for live-status inference because CoreWeave's 2023 company announcement projected full operation by 2023-12-31 and current official records show additional fit-up rather than a direct operating certificate.

actions.details: Approved tax-rebate agreement for CoreWeave, Inc. covering calendar years 2024-2031. Agreement requires CoreWeave to occupy at least 454,421 gross square feet at 1000 Coit Road, use the property as a data center, and add at least $1.6 billion of business personal property by the 2025 tax year.
CoreWeave announced a $1.6 billion Plano data center facility, its first Texas facility, expected to be fully operational by 2023-12-31.
R2026-025 / BAC COIT, Block 1, Lot 1R, for a data center on one 23.8-acre lot at 1000 Coit Road; listed on the 2026-08-06 Development Review List.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.details: TABS2026023537, Koala - Fit Up Phase 3, registered for a privately funded renovation/alteration: data center fit-up of 9,419 sf existing shell space plus supporting infrastructure and site improvements; start 2026-09-11, completion 2027-12-02, estimated cost $136 million.

capacity_notes: No official MW capacity located. Third-party trackers conflict: datacenter.fyi reports 13.75 MW / 8.25 MW IT load, DataCenterMap reports 30 MW, and a real-estate listing for 1000 Coit Road describes 13+ MW available and expandable to 24 MW.
owner: Lincoln Property Company / 1000 Coit Road LLC listed in 2026 official records as owner/site owner; CoreWeave, Inc. is the tenant/operator named in the 2023 Plano incentive agreement and company announcement.

sources.match_reason: Seed-only record matched to official Plano/TDLR records for 1000 Coit Road and CoreWeave's 2023 announcement.

contradictions.details: No official MW figure found. Third-party values conflict: datacenter.fyi reports 13.75 MW power capacity and 8.25 MW IT load; DataCenterMap labels the CoreWeave Plano entry as 30 MW; LoopNet describes the underlying 1000 Coit Road facility as 13+ MW available now and expandable to 24 MW.

CoreWeave's 2023 announcement said the facility would be fully operational by 2023-12-31, while 2026 official TDLR/Plano planning records show additional fit-up/replat activity. Status is therefore recorded as partial live / expansion fit-up registered rather than full buildout.
